newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to post 7 pct GNP growth - Goldman Sachs.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to post 7 pct GNP growth - Goldman Sachs.

text.p: Investment firm Goldman Sachs expects the Philippines to post a higher gross national product (GNP) growth rate of seven percent this year from an original forecast of 6.1 percent.
In a recent report which was obtained on Tuesday, Goldman Sachs also said average 1996 inflation in the Philippines could reach nine percent, slightly up from an earlier estimate of 8.8.
